from math import asin

schema T scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    z: Float mutable
    one: Float mutable
    two: Float mutable
    three: Float mutable
    half: Float mutable
    big: Float mutable

rule asin_pos_zero_is_pos_zero:
    T t where (asin(t.z) == 0.0) and ((1.0 / asin(t.z)) is inf)
->
    log info "a"

rule asin_neg_zero_is_neg_zero:
    T t where (asin(-t.z) == 0.0) and ((1.0 / asin(-t.z)) is -inf)
->
    log info "b"

rule asin_above_one_is_nan:
    T t where asin(t.two) is NaN
->
    log info "c"

rule asin_below_minus_one_is_nan:
    T t where asin(-t.two) is NaN
->
    log info "d"

rule asin_pos_inf_is_nan:
    T t where asin(t.big * t.big) is NaN
->
    log info "e"

rule asin_neg_inf_is_nan:
    T t where asin(-(t.big * t.big)) is NaN
->
    log info "f"
